offence_note: Offence not shown; material seized from car

note: Leave granted, sentence appeal dismissed; collateral consequences rejected as mitigating.

sentence_quote: On Count 1 of the indictment, I sentence you to a suspended sentence of 12 months, plus 15 months of probation. On Count 2 of the indictment, I sentence you to 30 days in jail, which you have already served, and 30 months' probation.

note: Mitigating factors unspecified; guilty pleas entered; credit computed from 2:1 figures.

offence_note: Robbery with firearm and possession of restricted weapon

note: Concurrent one year for weapon; unclear whether 3.5 years is before or after the one year credit.
